name: squeeze_washing_bottle
description: Partial configuration to squeeze washing bottle - only modifies right arm j6 to 0.3 while preserving all other joint positions

usage.description: This partial configuration only specifies j6 for the right arm. All other joints (j1-j5) will maintain their current values.

phosphobot_api.right_arm: POST /joints/write with j6=0.3 merged with current position

python_example.code:
# Only j6 will be modified, all other joints preserved
python3 execute_rules.py --config squeeze_washing_bottle
